title: 2027 Seoul Marathon — participant instructions and rules
publisher: Seoul Marathon Organizing Committee (The Dong-A Ilbo)
claims: Assembly on Sunday 21 March 2027 is 06:30 (tentative); the Full Marathon gathers at Gwanghwamun Square and the 10K at the Jamsil Sports Complex.
Time limits are 5 hours for the Full Marathon and 1 h 30 min for the 10K, enforced strictly; after the limit traffic control is lifted and the organiser bears no liability.
Aid: water and sports drink every 5 km and at the finish; sponges every 5 km after 7.5 km; snacks at 20 km and 30 km under the 2027 rules.
The disposable timing chip is attached to the back of the bib; net time is recorded.
Wheelchairs, inline skates and strollers are not allowed; group registration is not accepted, registration is individual only.

Overseas runners collect their items at the Seoul Running Expo at DDP no later than the day before the race; race-day venue pickup is restricted; items are not shipped internationally; the finisher medal is handed out on site to finishers only.

The overseas refund deadline is 18 December 2026, 17:00 KST; the domestic refund deadline is 30 November 2026, 14:00 KST; entries are non-transferable and non-resellable, substitution is treated as disqualification and may lead to a five-year future ban.

Start groups are S (Hall of Fame) plus A–H for the Full and A onward for the 10K; the organiser carries commercial general liability insurance and reserves the right to change the course or cancel under force majeure.
Full Marathon eligibility: age 18+, official full-marathon record certificate within 4:59:59 from races held 1 January 2024 to 30 November 2026; the 10K is open to all.
